axes: glTF +Y up. The front of each module faces -Z. bevy = (x, z, -y) from Blender

snaps.cell_center: Origin at the cell center on the floor top (y = 0). Place at (2.5 i, 0, 2.5 k).
snaps.edge_center: Origin at the middle of a cell edge on the floor top. Length along +-X (2.5 m). The front (conduit, frame stripes) faces -Z. Rotate about Y to face the interior.
snaps.vertex: Origin at a grid vertex on the floor top.
snaps.door_hinge: Origin at the hinge edge on the floor plane. The leaf extends along +X. Closed: hinge at the edge center - 0.59 m along the wall, yaw of the doorway.
snaps.wall_mount: Origin at the back center, on the wall face. The fixture protrudes to -Z. Choose the height at placement.
snaps.floor: Origin at the bottom center on the floor top. The front faces -Z.
snaps.surface: Local origin relative to a large prop. Place as a child with a fixed transform.
snaps.floor_line: Origin at the line center on the floor top (y = 0). x in [-0.5, 0.5], 0.1 m wide along Z, 3 mm high. Bevy scales along X to the run length.
snaps.ceiling_hang: Origin on the floor (y = 0) under the board center. The board hangs from rods to the ceiling.
